phrases.translation: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking
phrases.text: The earth is violently convulsed when the Hour comes. And the earth once spoke to Abdullah, who said to it: if it could speak, the Hour would come.

phrases.translation: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents
phrases.text: The earth brings forth what is inside it, the dead brought out alive. The dead in its interior were a burden on it, and alive on its surface they were a burden on it.

phrases.translation: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—
phrases.text: People say, when the earth is shaken at the coming of the Hour: what is wrong with the earth, and what is its account?

phrases.translation: on that Day the earth will recount everything
phrases.text: On that day the earth will tell her tidings. Ibn Abbas said this is said to the disbeliever, and that the earth speaks and says: God has commanded me this and revealed it to me and permitted it to me. Ibn Zayd says the tidings are what was done on her surface, good and evil.

phrases.translation: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺
phrases.text: The word means: He revealed to her.

phrases.translation: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups
phrases.text: The people come forth in scattered groups. Tabari notes that the words are placed out of their natural order here.
phrases.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ

phrases.translation: to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds
phrases.text: They come out of the place of reckoning in separate groups, one to the right toward the Garden and one to the left toward the Fire, so that each one sees his own deeds: the one who did good sees what God has prepared for him, and the one who did evil sees the recompense prepared for him.

phrases.translation: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it
phrases.text: Whoever does the weight of an atom of good will see its reward. The commentators say the believer sees his good deeds and then his bad ones, which are forgiven, while the disbeliever has his good deeds rejected and is punished for his bad ones. The atom, they say, is a red worm without weight.
phrases.ar: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرٗا يَرَهُۥ

phrases.translation: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it
phrases.text: And whoever does the weight of an atom of evil will see the requital for it. The Prophet said that what you dislike in this world is the weight of evil, while God keeps the weight of good for you until the day of resurrection.
phrases.ar: وَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٖ شَرّٗا يَرَهُۥ
